entities.summary: D. Leonor de Almeida Portugal, 4th Marquise of Alorna, 7th Countess of Assumar was a Portuguese noblewoman, painter, and poet. Commonly known by her penname, Alcipe, the Marquise was a prime figure in the Portuguese Neoclassic a proto-Romantic literary scene, while still a follower of Neoclassicism when it came to painting.
